humanRequest: Establish wallpaper, carpet and lighting identity from original Hotel Endless screenshots; image generation allowed.
workflow: Built-in image_gen; game base-color texture sources. No model or seed metadata exposed.
medallion: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: seamless square base-color texture for a 1970s hotel wall in a first-person game. Full-bleed orthographic FLAT wallpaper surface, no room, no perspective. An orderly repeated floral oval medallion pattern: exactly four evenly spaced columns and four rows of matching small ornate oval rosettes, muted dusty petrol teal background, sage olive and faded ochre outlines, little leafy diamond connectors. The overall pattern evokes tired but charming mid-century hotel luxury. Muted medium-value palette, fairly low contrast; broad readable shapes and subtle paper grain, not photoreal grunge. Seamless repeat across all four edges, regular pitch, same spacing at edges as inside. NO lighting, shadows, gradients, vignettes, stains, torn paper, borders, letters or objects. Square 1024x1024 texture.
angular: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: seamless square base-color texture for 1970s hotel corridor wallpaper. Full-bleed orthographic FLAT surface, no room or perspective. Regular repeating elongated nested diamonds and chevrons, four columns and four rows, slender muted sage-gray geometric ribbons on faded olive-tobacco ground, a touch of slate teal. Tired elegant retro hotel textile print, broad clear geometric forms and subtle matte paper grain, low contrast medium-value palette. Seamless repeat across all four edges, identical motif pitch at edges and inside. NO lighting, shadows, vignettes, irregular stains, borders, letters or objects. Square 1024x1024 texture.
carpet: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: seamless square base-color texture of fine woven hotel carpet for a first-person game. Full-bleed orthographic FLAT textile surface, no room or perspective. Neutral warm gray monochrome woven wool, a restrained tightly spaced broken herringbone and tiny diamond rhythm, small flecks of slightly lighter yarn. Medium gray values so the game can tint it to dark teal or burgundy. Stylized subdued texture with soft detail at game resolution, no sharp white fibers, no moire stripes. Seamless repeat across all four edges; even coverage and no central feature. NO lighting, shadows, vignettes, stains, borders, text or other objects. Square 1024x1024 texture.
